tools.description: Start here to learn how to complete work in Looksy. Returns purpose-based tool routes, creative and completion guidance, and this connection's capabilities. Choose overview, photo, design, timeline or delivery. Read live state next; this guide is not document state or editing authority.
tools.name: app.agent_guide
tools.title: Choose an Agent Workflow

tools.description: Find native app controls by domain and query. Paginated descriptors identify availability, resource ownership and reversal; unavailable commands explain the missing adapter. Fetch app.command_schema before invoking a discovered command. Use domain edit for fills, shapes, source images, groups, typography, layer effects and image controls.
tools.name: app.list_commands
tools.title: Discover Native App Commands

tools.description: Read the authoritative typed arguments and task contract for a commandId from app.list_commands. Layer targets use stable IDs returned by photo.inspect_composition; never invent an ID or pass a UI row index.
tools.name: app.command_schema
tools.title: Read Native Command Schema

tools.description: Invoke a readOnly native command using its discovered commandId and typed values. Rejects every mutable control; this tool requires read capability only. Use the invokeTool returned by app.command_schema.
tools.name: app.inspect_command
tools.title: Inspect Native Command

tools.description: Invoke an available native command using its exact discovered commandId and typed values. Mutations require an active owned agent draft and capture their full recipe in its revert journal. Returns actual createdLayerId(s), changed and taskStateHash. Unavailable or invalid commands fail before mutation. This tool does not grant commit or export capability.
tools.name: app.invoke_command
tools.title: Invoke Owned Native Command

tools.description: Return a compact summary of the active Timeline: resource ID, readiness, exportSnapshotReady and its breakdown, saved/dirty state, dimensions, frame rate, duration, and track count. Pass includeDocumentHash:false for lightweight repeated status polling without serializing the project; documentHash is then empty and cannot authorize mutations. Default true computes the deterministic hash when either readiness is true; inspect with the default before any guarded edit/save. Source manifests and checksums remain required before export. No paths, clips, tracks or keyframes are returned.
tools.name: timeline.inspect_document
tools.title: Inspect Active Timeline

tools.description: Return a paginated read-only snapshot of source media referenced by the active Timeline. Only photo, video, and audio clips with file paths are included; generated/non-file clips are omitted and offline sources remain visible. Rows are deduplicated by stable media ID, with a path-derived fallback when an ID is absent. Optional resourceId and documentHash must be supplied together to reject stale reads. The response contains at most 256 rows and never mutates the Timeline or catalog.

documentHash.description: Optional exact current documentHash from timeline.inspect_document; pair with resourceId to guard against stale reads.

resourceId.description: Optional exact active Timeline resourceId from timeline.inspect_document; pair with documentHash to guard against stale reads.

tools.name: timeline.inspect_used_media
tools.title: Inspect Media Used in Timeline

tools.description: Read a compact, paginated view of stable Timeline tracks or clips without building or returning the whole document projection. Clip rows include track stack order, sequence/source timing, blend/opacity, mask and effect summaries, and bounded keyframe channel names. Optional trackId, clipId, and query narrow the lookup. For clips, sequenceSeconds is rounded to the nearest sequence frame using std::round (ties away from zero); active clips use the exact half-open interval [startSeconds, endSeconds) at that sampled time, with no additional boundary tolerance. Optional resourceId/documentHash must be supplied together to reject stale reads. At most 64 rows are returned.

clipId.description: Optional exact stable clip ID. Available only for clips scope.

documentHash.description: Optional exact current documentHash from timeline.inspect_document; pair with resourceId to guard against stale reads.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive match on stable IDs, labels, media type, role, or clip title text.

resourceId.description: Optional exact active Timeline resourceId from timeline.inspect_document; pair with documentHash to guard against stale reads.

scope.description: Choose paginated clip rows or track rows.

sequenceSeconds.description: Optional clips-only active-time filter; time is sampled at the nearest sequence frame.

trackId.description: Optional exact stable track ID; filters track rows or clips on that track.

tools.name: timeline.inspect_structure
tools.title: Inspect Timeline Structure

tools.description: Read a paginated snapshot of editable Timeline review notes. Notes are frame-anchored or half-open frame ranges, may reference stable clip IDs, and include open/resolved state. Optional resourceId/documentHash must be supplied together to reject stale reads. This requires read capability and never changes the Timeline.

documentHash.description: Optional exact current documentHash; pair with resourceId to guard against stale reads.

noteId.description: Optional stable markerId for one note.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive search over note text, label, assignee and clip IDs.

resourceId.description: Optional exact active Timeline resourceId from timeline.inspect_document; pair with documentHash.

tools.name: timeline.inspect_review_notes
tools.title: Inspect Timeline Review Notes

tools.description: List readable app-managed Timeline documents by stable ID. No filesystem path is accepted. This tool is read-only and available with read capability.
tools.name: timeline.list_saved_drafts
tools.title: List Saved Timeline Drafts

tools.description: List only the opaque IDs and display names for exact native project files granted at app startup. This is read-only and requires read capability; filesystem paths and project contents are never returned.
tools.name: timeline.list_project_inputs
tools.title: List Granted Timeline Project Inputs

tools.description: Import one exact startup-granted native project as a new app-managed Library copy. Requires draft capability, confirmed:true, no active Timeline or task, and active edit access. Only the returned inputId is accepted; arbitrary paths are not. Clip and track IDs are retained, the new project receives a fresh Timeline ID, and source bytes remain unchanged. If the reply is uncertain, inspect the current document and saved drafts; do not replay.

confirmed.description: Explicit confirmation to create and open a managed project copy.

inputId.description: Exact opaque inputId returned by timeline.list_project_inputs.

tools.name: timeline.import_project_input
tools.title: Import Granted Timeline Project Copy

tools.description: Create and natively save a named empty Timeline as a new app-managed Library project, then activate the visible Timeline workspace. Requires draft capability, no active Timeline, and no active or review-held task. The new UUID-backed project is created before task admission and is not journal-revertible. If the reply is uncertain, call timeline.inspectAgentDocument and timeline.list_saved_drafts; do not replay this command.
tools.name: timeline.create_draft
tools.title: Create Empty Timeline Draft

tools.description: Start a native asynchronous save of the exact active Timeline without queueing a Gallery render. Requires draft capability, confirmed:true, the current resourceId and stable documentHash, and no active or review-held task. Poll timeline.inspect_document until saveInProgress is false, saveFailed is false, and dirty is false; use its readback documentHash for timeline.close_saved_draft because the first Library save may initialize managed output paths. No paths are accepted; an uncertain request must be inspected, not replayed.

confirmed.description: Explicit confirmation to save the active Timeline draft.

documentHash.description: Current stable documentHash returned by timeline.inspect_document.

resourceId.description: Exact active resourceId returned by timeline.inspect_document.

tools.name: timeline.save_active_draft
tools.title: Save Active Timeline Draft

tools.description: Close only the exact active Timeline after its asynchronous save has completed successfully. Requires draft capability, confirmed:true, matching resourceId and stable documentHash, no active or review-held task, dirty=false, saveInProgress=false, saveFailed=false, and an app-managed canonical Library file whose readback hash matches. The tool accepts no path and never discards edits or cancels durable render jobs. If a guard fails, the Timeline remains open; inspect status and retry only after resolving it.

confirmed.description: Explicit confirmation to close the verified saved Timeline.

documentHash.description: Stable documentHash that was successfully saved and read back.

resourceId.description: Exact active resourceId returned by timeline.inspect_document.

tools.name: timeline.close_saved_draft
tools.title: Close Verified Saved Timeline Draft

tools.description: Open an existing app-managed Library Timeline by its exact ID and activate the visible Timeline workspace. Returns compact identity/readiness, not the clip/keyframe graph; use timeline.inspect_structure for bounded detail. Arbitrary paths, fallback recovery copies, and switching away from an active Timeline are rejected. Requires draft capability and no active or review-held task. Navigation is not journal-revertible; if the reply is uncertain, inspect the current document instead of replaying.
tools.name: timeline.open_saved_draft
tools.title: Open Saved Timeline Draft

tools.description: Open only the app-managed autosave whose stable document hash matches the supplied Timeline ID and hash. No paths are accepted. Requires draft capability, no active Timeline, and no active or review-held task. This starts an asynchronous recovery; poll timeline.inspect_autosave_recovery until the resource is ready, then verify the exact resource and documentHash with app.inspect_command before calling timeline.recover_task. Do not replay an uncertain request.

documentHash.description: Expected stable documentHash from the task checkpoint or recovery evidence.

timelineId.description: Exact managed Timeline ID whose autosave should be recovered.

tools.name: timeline.open_autosave_recovery
tools.title: Open Exact Timeline Autosave Recovery

tools.description: Read the asynchronous status for one exact Timeline ID and autosave documentHash. Reports opening/completion, the observed resource identity/readiness and whether the native Timeline workspace activated. It does not open or alter a recovery.
tools.name: timeline.inspect_autosave_recovery
tools.title: Inspect Timeline Autosave Recovery

tools.description: Create a reversible task for exactly one open Timeline. Use resourceId from timeline.inspectAgentDocument. Every source path must be a canonical existing regular file, and outputDirectory must be an existing canonical directory. The confirmed action plan derives native style permissions; this does not grant export or commit. The task checkpoints the Timeline before any edit and retains path scope for import and save commands.

summary.description: One concise approved action, at most 180 characters.

items.description: Canonical source file path admitted for this task.

confirmed.description: Must be true to admit this exact Timeline and path scope.

objective.description: Approved native editing objective for this Timeline task.

outputDirectory.description: Existing canonical directory where this task may create its native project file.

tools.name: timeline.admit_task
tools.title: Admit Native Timeline Task

tools.description: Read the active native Timeline task, its exact resource target and approved path scope, status, journal resources and receipts.
tools.name: timeline.inspect_task
tools.title: Inspect Native Timeline Task

tools.description: Cancel a pending Timeline admission preparation and resume canceled derived media and preview work. This is available only before a task has been admitted; active tasks still require continue or revert.
tools.name: timeline.cancel_task_preparation
tools.title: Cancel Timeline Task Preparation

tools.description: Move the active task to review or continue the same reversible task after review. Review stops further edits until continue; it never commits or exports.
tools.name: timeline.finish_task
tools.title: Finish Native Timeline Task

tools.description: Release this Timeline task's active ownership after review so another task can be admitted. Its journal, baseline and task-owned outputs remain available for recovery or revert; this does not commit or export.

confirmed.description: Must be true to release active Timeline ownership while retaining the recovery journal.

tools.name: timeline.release_reviewed_task
tools.title: Release Reviewed Timeline Draft

tools.description: Restore every task-owned native resource and remove only task-created project files whose absent-file baselines are still intact. Requires confirmed:true; conflicts preserve the current edits and recovery baseline.

confirmed.description: Must be true to restore the task baseline.

tools.name: timeline.revert_task
tools.title: Revert Native Timeline Task

tools.description: Reattach the exact active native Timeline and task-owned output files to a journal recovered from disk. Recovery never replays an uncertain command.

targetResourceId.description: Exact Timeline resourceId stored in the recovered journal.

tools.name: timeline.recover_task
tools.title: Recover Native Timeline Task

tools.description: Read playback health, preview route and quality, dropped-frame count, smoothed per-stage timing, and cumulative color-LUT cache hits, misses, evictions, and accounted payload bytes. Timings are an EWMA updated from completed worker frames and exclude decoder wait and display presentation. The measurement source key identifies the clip, rendered dimensions, and input transform; no media path is returned. Cache byte counts cover accounted vector payloads, not total process or GPU memory.
tools.name: timeline.inspect_playback_performance
tools.title: Inspect Playback Performance

tools.description: Read actual Timeline Program QQuickItem geometry for one stable clip id, a bounded scalar summary of the QML track/Program projections, and the latest wheel packet captured passively at the current Timeline window before QML delivery and by the two wheel handlers. Returns only fixed whitelists of Program objects, projection counts, and wheel fields; it retains no event history and does not change the playhead, timeline or UI state.

clipId.description: Stable Timeline clip id whose Program geometry should be inspected.

tools.name: timeline.inspect_render_geometry
tools.title: Inspect Program Render Geometry

tools.description: Read Timeline delivery readiness, media and audio issues, recommended output variant, estimated disk requirement, and available space for one supported preset. This reports readiness only and does not start or authorize export.

preset.description: Optional output preset; defaults to the active Timeline preset.

tools.name: timeline.inspect_delivery_preflight
tools.title: Inspect Timeline Delivery Preflight

tools.description: Read at most 20 render jobs whose stable Timeline resource ID matches the currently open Timeline. Returns status, stage, progress, render failure, submission error, queue history state, and only document/output paths that resolve inside this Timeline's known path scope. This cannot queue, retry, cancel, or export jobs.
tools.name: timeline.inspect_render_jobs
tools.title: Inspect Timeline Render Jobs

tools.description: Queue one native H.264 export for the exact open Timeline revision. Requires the export capability and confirmed:true. Without range, the app exports the full timeline. With range.startFrame and range.endFrameExclusive, it exports a native review excerpt using global sequence frames in a half-open interval lasting between 1 and 15 seconds. The app creates a unique output under its managed Timeline renders folder, pins an immutable Timeline snapshot and relevant source checksums, and enforces a 16 GiB full-export or 256 MiB excerpt ceiling. No output path, codec command, or process identifier is accepted. Use the returned requestId as the durable receipt for status or cancellation.

confirmed.description: Explicit confirmation to queue this one H.264 export.

endFrameExclusive.description: Exclusive end on the exact global sequence frame clock; range duration must be between 1 and 15 seconds.

startFrame.description: Inclusive start on the exact global sequence frame clock.

requestId.description: Client-generated canonical UUID used as the idempotency key; reuse this exact value only to replay this export request.

tools.name: timeline.export_h264
tools.title: Export Timeline H.264

tools.description: Read the exact export job identified by its requestId, resourceId, and documentHash receipt. Only app-owned MCP H.264 exports for the currently open Timeline are visible; this does not retry or mutate a job.

resourceId.description: Exact Timeline resourceId stored in the export receipt.

tools.name: timeline.inspect_export
tools.title: Inspect Timeline Export Receipt

tools.description: Request cooperative cancellation for the exact app-owned MCP H.264 export identified by its receipt. This cannot cancel an arbitrary Timeline render, job, or process.

resourceId.description: Exact Timeline resourceId stored in the export receipt.

tools.name: timeline.cancel_export
tools.title: Cancel Timeline Export

tools.description: Pause native Timeline playback, move the active Timeline playhead to the requested sequence time, and reveal it in the horizontal Timeline viewport. Requires the exact active resourceId and current documentHash from timeline.inspectAgentDocument, and an active visible Timeline workspace. This is read-only view navigation: it does not edit the document or task journal. The receipt verifies the playhead is within the viewport but does not verify decoded frame presentation; it does not capture a screenshot or claim that the requested frame is displayed.

resourceId.description: Exact active Timeline resourceId from timeline.inspectAgentDocument.

tools.name: timeline.preview_at_time
tools.title: Seek Native Timeline Preview

tools.description: Apply one allowlisted, reversible Timeline view action: fit the sequence, fit the current selection, choose an Editing/Color/Audio/Finish workspace preset, or play/pause. Requires the exact active resourceId and documentHash from timeline.inspectAgentDocument and the visible active Timeline workspace. This read-only navigation does not alter the Timeline document or task journal. The receipt reports UI state and explicitly leaves frame presentation unverified.

resourceId.description: Exact active Timeline resourceId from timeline.inspectAgentDocument.

tools.name: timeline.navigate_view
tools.title: Navigate Native Timeline View

tools.description: Request one fresh snapshot of the currently visible Looksy Timeline window at native display-pixel dimensions. The first call returns a captureId, logical target size, expected physical pixel size, and display scale; poll this same tool with only that captureId for the completed PNG path, actual pixel size, and bound Timeline resource, document hash, and playhead. It does not change the Timeline document and writes only to the private app proof cache, capped at 16 images and 512 MiB without deleting earlier proofs. Capture is unavailable when the current Timeline window is hidden, unexposed, headless, or changes during capture. It does not capture arbitrary windows or accept a target or output path.

captureId.description: Optional captureId returned by this tool; omit it to request one new capture.

tools.name: timeline.capture_visible_proof
tools.title: Capture Visible Timeline Proof

tools.description: Request a bounded 480 by 270 capture of the displayed Program Monitor and open the Timeline scopes panel. Capture and analysis are asynchronous; poll timeline.inspect_program_color_scopes until analysisBusy is false and revision advances. Scope measurements describe 8-bit SDR monitor output, not source-linear or HDR pixels.
tools.name: timeline.capture_program_color_scopes
tools.title: Capture Program Color Scopes

tools.description: Read compact RGB and luma mean, percentile, and near-black or near-white summaries from the latest bounded Program Monitor scope capture. The response identifies sample size, revision, freshness, and 8-bit SDR display precision; it does not return full histogram or waveform arrays.
tools.name: timeline.inspect_program_color_scopes
tools.title: Inspect Program Color Scopes

tools.description: Read the color input transform, creative LUT, shot-match gains, and affected sequence range for a stable clip id in the active timeline. When this clip is the current Program frame, also return Qt decoder-reported frame color metadata, the preview conversion path, and any conversion warning; those tags do not identify a camera log profile.
tools.name: timeline.inspect_clip_color
tools.title: Inspect Clip Color

tools.description: Open the existing Program Comparison window on a video or photo clip by stable id. By default, the comparison opens at the clip midpoint; sequenceSeconds can select another visible moment inside the clip. The captured Program frame becomes the reference for iterative visual review. This changes the playhead and window state only; it does not modify the timeline document or undo history.

clipId.description: Stable video or photo timeline clip id.

mode.description: Optional initial comparison layout; defaults to wipe.

sequenceSeconds.description: Optional sequence time inside the clip; defaults to its midpoint. The clip must be the visible Program clip at this time.

tools.name: timeline.open_program_comparison
tools.title: Open Program Color Comparison

tools.description: Read generic FFmpeg stream color fields and bounded Sony gamma, gamut, monitoring, or transform tags from a video clip's source file by stable clip id. When explicit Gamma for Look and Color for Look tags exactly match a supported Sony S-Log pair, return a suggested input transform. This reads metadata only and never selects or changes the clip transform; missing, conflicting, or unrecognized pairs remain unresolved.
tools.name: timeline.inspect_clip_source_color_metadata
tools.title: Inspect Clip Source Color Metadata

tools.description: Read a picture clip's ordered effect stack, enabled state, current values at the sequence playhead, and keyframe information by stable id.
tools.name: timeline.inspect_clip_effects
tools.title: Inspect Clip Effects

tools.description: Read the photo-engine grade recipe on a photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip, its preview render mode, and sequence-export capability. Still-photo recipes currently require static pointwise operations; video and adjustment clips retain the existing broader preview route. For pointwise grades, inspection compiles or loads the shared-engine CUBE and reports its interpolation-fidelity validation, cube size, p99 error, and maximum error. Spatial or image-dependent grades remain preview-only for sequence export.

clipId.description: Stable photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip id.

tools.name: timeline.inspect_clip_color_grade
tools.title: Inspect Clip Color Grade

tools.description: Attach a validated photo-engine recipe to a photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip. Still-photo clips currently accept only static pointwise recipes with no masks or image-dependent operations; RAW-camera sources are not supported by this Timeline grade path yet. Adjustment clips apply the grade to the picture composite beneath them. Sequence export supports pointwise recipes through a shared-engine CUBE LUT; spatial masks and image-dependent operations are not yet supported by sequence export.

clipId.description: Stable photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip id.

recipe.description: Complete photo edit recipe object. Inspect the clip first, then provide the updated recipe.

tools.name: timeline.set_clip_color_grade
tools.title: Set Clip Color Grade

tools.description: Edit the ordered photo-engine adjustment layers on a photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip by stable clip and layer ids. Still-photo recipes must remain static and pointwise; any layer mask or image-dependent operation is rejected. Operations add, replace, move, enable, set opacity, set a supported blend mode, set one grade parameter, or remove one adjustment layer. Add and replace take a complete adjustment layer object; position 0 is the top of the stack. Each edit is validated and undoable.

blendMode.description: Adjustment-layer compositing mode; used only with set_blend_mode.

clipId.description: Stable photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip id.

enabled.description: New enabled state; used only with set_enabled.

layer.description: Complete adjustment layer object with a stable id and kind 'adjustment'; required for add and replace.

layerId.description: Stable id of the adjustment layer to edit; required except for add.

opacity.description: Layer opacity from 0 to 1; used only with set_opacity.

parameter.description: Supported photo-engine adjustment-layer control, including three-way color grading; used only with set_parameter.

position.description: Zero-based stack index. Required for move and optional for add; 0 is the top.

value.description: New grade value; used only with set_parameter. Values are clamped to the supported control range.

tools.name: timeline.edit_clip_color_grade_layer
tools.title: Edit Clip Color Grade Layer

tools.description: Set or reset one RGB, luma, or individual-channel point curve on a photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip. Still-photo recipes must remain static and pointwise. Pass an empty points array to reset the curve. Provide layerId to target a stable adjustment layer; edits are validated and undoable.

clipId.description: Stable photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip id.

layerId.description: Optional stable id of the adjustment layer to edit.

points.description: Ordered curve points in the normalized 0 to 1 range; use an empty array to reset the selected channel.

tools.name: timeline.set_clip_color_grade_curve
tools.title: Set Clip Color Grade Curve

tools.description: Set one supported pointwise photo-engine control on a photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip by stable id. Still photos support static pointwise recipes only. Adjustment clips grade the picture composite beneath them. Values update the existing grade recipe and are undoable; supported parameters include exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, temperature, tint, vibrance, saturation, and the hue, saturation, and luminance controls for shadow, midtone, and highlight color grading.

clipId.description: Stable photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip id.

parameter.description: Supported photo-engine grade parameter name, including three-way grading wheel controls.

tools.name: timeline.set_clip_color_grade_parameter
tools.title: Set Clip Color Grade Parameter

tools.description: Remove the shared photo-engine grade recipe from a photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip by stable id. This is undoable.

clipId.description: Stable photo, video, or timeline adjustment clip id.

tools.name: timeline.clear_clip_color_grade
tools.title: Clear Clip Color Grade

tools.description: Edit a picture clip's ordinary timeline effect stack by stable id. Operations add, remove, reorder, enable, clear, or set one effect amount. Amount edits on animated effects write at the current sequence playhead and preserve existing keyframes. Each edit is undoable.

amount.description: Exposure, Contrast, and Saturation accept -1 to 1; other effects accept 0 to 1. Values are clamped to that range.

tools.name: timeline.edit_clip_effects
tools.title: Edit Clip Effects

tools.description: Create a transparent adjustment clip over the picture tracks at an explicit sequence start time. The new stable clip id can be passed to timeline.edit_clip_effects and timeline.set_clip_opacity. Duration is limited to the remaining sequence range.

durationSeconds.description: Requested duration in seconds; clipped at the sequence end.

tools.name: timeline.add_adjustment_clip
tools.title: Add Timeline Adjustment Clip

tools.description: Set the opacity of a picture clip, including a timeline adjustment clip, by stable id. If the clip already has opacity keyframes, this writes or updates a keyframe at the current sequence playhead; otherwise it changes the clip-wide value.

opacity.description: Opacity from fully transparent (0) to fully opaque (1).

tools.name: timeline.set_clip_opacity
tools.title: Set Timeline Clip Opacity

tools.description: Set or remove a transform, opacity, audio-gain, ordinary effect-amount, or shared photo-grade control keyframe by stable clip id. Grade keyframes are currently supported on video and adjustment clips only; still-photo shared grades are static pointwise recipes. Use grade:<parameter> for the clip's base photo grade, or grade:layer:<stable-layer-id>:<parameter> for a photo adjustment layer on that clip. Both require the shared grade recipe and target layer to exist. Grade controls include exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, temperature, tint, vibrance, saturation, and the shadows/midtones/highlights wheel hue, saturation, and luminance channels. localSeconds is measured from the trimmed clip start. Call set at two or more times to create an animated curve; interpolation is linear by default and can use hold, easing, or Bezier.

interpolation.description: Optional interpolation for set; omitted updates preserve the existing interpolation.

localSeconds.description: Time from the trimmed clip start in seconds.

parameter.description: Opacity, transform, audio gain, effect:<name>, grade:<parameter>, or grade:layer:<stable-layer-id>:<parameter>. Grade layer ids come from timeline.inspect_clip_color_grade.

value.description: Keyframe value; required for set and clamped to the parameter range.

tools.name: timeline.edit_clip_keyframe
tools.title: Edit Timeline Clip Keyframe

tools.description: Set automatic source-tag detection, a manual bypass, or a supported Sony S-Log input transform on a video clip by stable id. Automatic mode applies a transform only when file metadata has one exact supported Gamma for Look and Color for Look pair. This is undoable and marks color-derived render output as needing regeneration.

clipId.description: Stable id of a video clip in the active timeline.

profile.description: Use auto for exact supported file-tag detection, none for a manual bypass, or a supported Sony camera transform.

tools.name: timeline.set_video_input_transform
tools.title: Set Video Input Transform

tools.description: Validate and assign a readable .cube file to a picture clip by stable id. Supports the photo engine's 1D, 3D, and shaper-plus-3D formats; the edit is undoable.

filePath.description: Absolute local path to a .cube LUT.

tools.name: timeline.set_clip_color_lut
tools.title: Set Clip CUBE LUT

tools.description: Remove the creative CUBE LUT from a picture clip by stable id. The edit is undoable.
tools.name: timeline.clear_clip_color_lut
tools.title: Clear Clip CUBE LUT

tools.description: Set the bounded RGB shot-match gains on a picture clip by stable id. Values of 1.0 reset a channel; the edit is undoable and invalidates color-derived render output.

blueGain.description: Finite per-channel multiplier from 0.5 to 2.0; use 1.0 to reset.

greenGain.description: Finite per-channel multiplier from 0.5 to 2.0; use 1.0 to reset.

redGain.description: Finite per-channel multiplier from 0.5 to 2.0; use 1.0 to reset.

tools.name: timeline.set_clip_shot_match_gains
tools.title: Set Clip Shot-Match Gains

tools.description: Start local visual search from one search-and-edit instruction. Never edits or confirms targets. The user must review matches and confirm in the app. Poll photo.search_edit_status.
tools.name: photo.search_edit_start
tools.title: Find Photos for an Edit

tools.description: Read search progress, interpreted instructions and candidate ids. Approval is only available in the local app.
tools.name: photo.search_edit_status
tools.title: Search and Edit Status

tools.description: Stop an unconfirmed photo search. Does not cancel or commit an active draft.
tools.name: photo.search_edit_cancel
tools.title: Cancel Search

tools.description: Read the current app, selection, agent, and draft status.
tools.name: photo.live_status
tools.title: Photo Live Status

tools.description: Read available local agent models and the selected model id.
tools.name: photo.list_models
tools.title: List Agent Models

tools.description: Read selected asset ids and selected asset count.
tools.name: photo.selected_assets
tools.title: Selected Assets

tools.description: Read metadata for the selected asset or a requested asset id.
tools.name: photo.read_asset
tools.title: Read Asset

tools.description: Read the selected asset as a canonical asset-bound adjustment patch.
tools.name: photo.read_adjustments
tools.title: Read Adjustments

tools.description: Compatibility-only read of the selected asset's legacy recipe projection.
tools.name: photo.read_recipe
tools.title: Read Legacy Recipe

tools.description: Read the validation-backed schema for agent recipe patch tools.
tools.name: photo.get_recipe_patch_schema
tools.title: Recipe Patch Schema

tools.description: Read the selected style rulebook, constraints, allowed tools, and batch policy.
tools.name: photo.get_style_rulebook
tools.title: Style Rulebook

tools.description: Validate a recipe patch before applying it.
tools.name: photo.validate_recipe_patch
tools.title: Validate Recipe Patch

tools.description: Render a proof image for the current selected asset.
tools.name: photo.render_current_proof
tools.title: Render Current Proof

tools.description: Render and validate the current selected edit state.
tools.name: photo.validate_edit
tools.title: Validate Current Edit

tools.description: Read the open photo's layers in top-first order, stable ids, selection ids, canvas dimensions, and installed fonts. Call photo.inspect_composition with {assetId}; omit operation and values to receive the authoritative exact family-to-face inventory in fontFaces entries {family,faces}. Choose one exact family and face string from that inventory; do not probe guessed face names to discover styles. With no family/face requested, font availability and fontAxes fields are omitted, not false. If verifying one selected pair, pass values {family,face}; the requested names are echoed without substitution, fontFamilyAvailable/fontFaceAvailable report that exact pair, requestedFamilyFaces lists the selected family's faces, and fontAxes may be empty for an available fixed font.
tools.name: photo.inspect_composition
tools.title: Inspect Photo Composition

tools.description: Edit the open photo through the same undoable controls as the user. Read state first using photo.inspect_composition with {assetId}; inspect is not an edit operation. Operations and values: add_text {text,x,y} creates point text; add_paragraph_text {text,x,y,width,height} creates paragraph text in document pixels; text_range_style {start,end,textSnapshot,style} formats a UTF-16 range on a stable layerId; textSnapshot must match the inspected current copy and style accepts family,size,weight,italic,underline,color,strokeWidth,strokeColor; add_pixel_layer {} creates an empty editable transparent paint layer and returns createdLayerId; add_source_layer {} creates an editable linked source layer from the open photo and returns createdLayerId, allowing effects to stay editable above the base image; text {text}; typography {family,face,size,weight,italic,underline,color,tracking,lineHeight,strokeWidth,strokeColor,shadowX,shadowY,shadowColor,mode,paragraphSpacing,axes,pathPoints,pathContours,pathStart,pathEnd,pathOffset,pathSpacing,pathSide,pathClosed,pathExclusion,material,materialTint,materialBlur,materialTransmission,materialEdgeSoftness,materialDepth,materialLightAngle}; axes is a map of supported OpenType tags; photo.inspect_composition accepts values {family,face} and returns fontAxes with supported tags and ranges before values are chosen; pathPoints is an ordered list of normalized {x,y} baseline points, with pathStart/pathEnd selecting a path interval, pathOffset moving text to either side, pathSpacing adding tracking in document pixels, and pathSide choosing the contour side, pathContours preserving multiple closed mask outlines including holes, and pathExclusion=true flowing paragraph lines around those contours through the widest free interval. Contour text without exclusion remains single-line. material is none, frosted_glass, smoked_plastic, soft_emboss, polished_chrome, brushed_silver, warm_gold, copper, dark_steel, champagne_gold, rose_gold, antique_brass, titanium, or black_chrome; materialTint sets the material color, materialBlur controls glass backdrop blur, materialTransmission controls glass transparency or metal reflectivity, materialEdgeSoftness and materialDepth shape the bevel, and materialLightAngle moves the studio reflections and edge light. Metal finishes use directional reflection bands and glyph-edge relief so they remain visibly metallic as tint, depth, and light are edited. Glass reads only layers below the text; upper layers remain composited afterward. text_path {maskId,contourIndex?} detaches a traced selection contour into the selected text layer; query the font face's available axes before setting values, and leave axes empty for static fonts; paint {layerId,points,color,size,hardness,opacity,flow,spacing,textureMaterial,textureStrength,textureScale,textureAngle,textureSeed,pressureSize,pressureFlow,clipSelection,lightFalloff,lightExposure,lightTaper,lightAccumulation,tipLayerId,tipPresetName,tipRotationVariation,tipScaleVariation}; points are canvas-pixel {x,y,pressure} samples on an unlocked pixel layer. textureMaterial is solid, dry_ink, graphite, light_paint, or photo_fragment; photo_fragment accepts exactly one of tipLayerId or tipPresetName and uses seeded tipRotationVariation/tipScaleVariation; save_photo_fragment_preset {name,tipLayerId or sourcePresetName,rotationVariation?,scaleVariation?,overwrite?}, import_photo_fragment_preset {path,overwrite?}, export_photo_fragment_preset {name,path}, and delete_photo_fragment_preset {name} manage portable Photo Fragment assets. inspect returns photoFragmentBrushPresets. light_paint adds a soft HDR halo controlled by lightFalloff (0-1), lightExposure (-8 to +8 EV), lightTaper (0-1 at both stroke ends), and lightAccumulation (boolean). For photo_fragment, first create an independent cutout with copy_selection {maskId,independent:true}, inspect to get its pixel-layer ID, then save_photo_fragment_preset with that tipLayerId; paint later with tipPresetName even if the source layer has changed or been removed. The stamp keeps soft alpha and holes. tipRotationVariation is seeded degrees (0-180) and tipScaleVariation is seeded size variance (0-0.9). poll inspect until paintBusy is false and check paintError; transform {x,y,scale,rotation}; perspective {horizontal,vertical}; move {position} (0 is top); copy_selection {maskId,independent?} (omit layerId for the base photo, or provide a content-layer ID to copy that layer through the selection while intersecting its existing mask; independent=true rasterizes the selected content layer and its masks into a self-contained pixel cutout); erase_selection {maskId} (pixel layer required; queues an undoable pixel erase; poll inspect until paintBusy is false and check paintError); select_subject {} (reports an error if segmentation is unavailable); lasso_selection {points,subtract?,feather?} creates a closed editable selection from 3 to 4096 normalized image coordinates, returns createdMaskId, and accepts normalized feather 0-0.05 for soft-edged cutouts; use it to isolate a specific reflection or other detail before copy_selection. blur {sigma}; opacity {opacity}; add_effect {effectType plus type-specific registered effect controls}; update_effect {effectId plus changed controls}; remove_effect {effectId}; reorder_effect {effectId,position} where position is the zero-based effect row within that layer; mask_effect {effectId,maskId} creates an effect mask from an existing selection; clear_effect_mask {effectId}. Effect IDs are returned by add_effect and listed by inspect. These operations use the same undoable layer-effect stack as the editor. Supply only changed typography fields. For text behind a subject: generate or reuse a selection, add and style text, then copy_selection with independent=true and no layerId to place a self-contained cutout above text. Changes apply directly to the open document and support ordinary Undo; they are not agent drafts.

x.description: Normalized image coordinate from zero to one.

y.description: Normalized image coordinate from zero to one.

values.description: Partial text typography update. Distances are canvas pixels; path points are normalized. Inspect available fonts/faces/axes before selecting them.

axes.description: Supported font axis tags mapped to values within the inspected native axis ranges.

color.description: Qt color name or hex. Prefer opaque six-digit #RRGGBB. Eight-digit hex is Qt #AARRGGBB for intentional alpha, never CSS #RRGGBBAA.

lineHeight.description: Line-height multiplier; 1.0 is the normal line advance.

materialTint.description: Qt color name or hex. Prefer opaque six-digit #RRGGBB. Eight-digit hex is Qt #AARRGGBB for intentional alpha, never CSS #RRGGBBAA.

shadowColor.description: Qt color name or hex. Prefer opaque six-digit #RRGGBB. Eight-digit hex is Qt #AARRGGBB for intentional alpha, never CSS #RRGGBBAA.

strokeColor.description: Qt color name or hex. Prefer opaque six-digit #RRGGBB. Eight-digit hex is Qt #AARRGGBB for intentional alpha, never CSS #RRGGBBAA.

tracking.description: Qt AbsoluteSpacing: additional canvas pixels between glyphs. Zero is normal; 40 adds 40 canvas pixels between glyphs.

layerId.description: Stable existing layer ID at the top level of arguments. Required for operations that edit a layer. Use an inspected ID or a prior creation receipt; never predict a new ID.

position.description: Zero-based integer layer or effect position; zero is top.

rotation.description: Layer rotation in degrees about its center; 0 is unrotated. The editor clamps transform rotation to -3600 through 3600.

scale.description: Uniform layer-size multiplier; 1 is unscaled. The editor clamps transform scale to 0.05 through 32.

size.description: Typography font size in document pixels, not points or screen pixels. Paint size is in canvas pixels. Layer scale multiplies visible size.
Typography font size in document pixels, not points or screen pixels. Paint size is in canvas pixels. Layer scale multiplies visible size.

x.description: Integer canvas-pixel coordinate, not normalized. add_text places the text origin; transform sets the layer raster's top-left before rotation. Inspect x/y, textOriginX/Y and pixel dimensions after styling.

y.description: Integer canvas-pixel coordinate, not normalized. add_text places the text origin; transform sets the layer raster's top-left before rotation. Inspect x/y, textOriginX/Y and pixel dimensions after styling.
